decision: Selected the site location that the Environment Agency's installations register publishes for permit EPR/YP3329SB (holder VDC LHR11 Limited, 'LHR11/12', 2 Black Arrow House, Chandos Road, London NW10 6NF): latitude 51.527115, longitude -0.254983 (grid reference TQ2115082355), copied without transformation, as the project locator. It is the regulator's site point for the permitted installation, not a building outline or surveyed position.

selected_properties.activities: Combustion; Any Fuel =>50MW - 1.1 A(1) a); Directly Associated Activity
selected_properties.address: 2 Black Arrow House, LHR11/12, Chandos Rd, London, NW10 6NF

transform.note: No transform is applied to the published latitude and longitude. Check only: pyproj 3.7.1 EPSG:27700 -> EPSG:4326 of the register's easting and northing gives 51.5271204, -0.2549901, 0.7 m from the published point.

consistency_checks.planning_polygon: The London Planning Datahub polygon of OPDC record 23/0176/NMAOPDC (non-material amendment to the parameter plan of outline permission 21/0013/OUTOPDC for a data centre of up to 52,000 sq m GEA at the Chandos Road Trading Estate; 5 vertices, 2.02 ha, centroid E 521140.18 N 182382.50) contains the register point, 47.8 m inside its boundary and 29.2 m from its centroid; the 2.26 ha polygon of 24/0146/NMAOPDC on the same site also contains it (49.2 m inside). The 1.34 ha Phase 1a reserved-matters polygon (21/0150/REMOPDC) lies 16 m from the point. Computed with shapely 2.1.1 in EPSG:27700.
consistency_checks.postcode_centroid: The ONS centroid of NW10 6NF (postcodes.io: E 521124, N 182413) lies 64 m north-north-west of the register point, so the register point is not a copy of the postcode centroid; the centroid is not used.
consistency_checks.imagery: Esri World Imagery z17 tiles (x 65440-65444, y 43568-43574; sha256 of the sorted per-tile shasum lines a008e47f0f3f70e6480152b85e664221b08b7e5678110ae74f20b58d8021cf84) viewed locally and not redistributed: the point falls in a cleared construction area immediately south of a tall dark building with roof plant, between the railway to the east and the industrial estate roads to the west, matching the inspection's description of one building near completion and a second separate building not yet started. The imagery date is unknown and is not used as status evidence.
consistency_checks.other_sites: The point is 735 m south-east of the register point for Vantage's LHR21 permit at 37-39 North Acton Road (a separate campus), 434 m from Equinix's and 489 m from Colt's Powergate permit points, 782 m from the Atlas Kao Data Park Royal locator and 1.59 km from the Atlas Pure DC / SEGRO LON02 locator.

uncertainty: The register publishes no positional accuracy and does not say which part of the site it marks; the two-building campus covers about 2 ha around the point.
